newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner fails to find Cunard buyer - FT.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner fails to find Cunard buyer - FT.

text.p: Kvaerner ASA has failed to find a buyer or joint venture partner for its Cunard subsidiary after demanding almost $600 million for the cruise line, the Financial Times newspaper said.
"Companies have entered talks but they have broken down over the financial negotiations," the newspaper quoted an unnamed Cunard executive as saying.

According to Cunard estimates, Kvaerner is not only seeking $325 million for the five-ship fleet, but a further premium for the brand name and a commitment of $240 million to $250 million from any buyer to build a new cruise ship at its Masa yard in Finland.
